Pwn request attacks still beat GitHub Actions defenses
GitHub package firewall guards coding agents

P.h: HHS filing puts iRhythm breach at 8.2 million people
P.p: Hackers accessed iRhythm's third-party-hosted business applications in June, demanded a ransom and threatened to leak the data. HHS now lists 8,179,772 people as affected. Exposed data includes names, contact details, dates of birth, account and device identifiers, insurance numbers and service dates.
P.s: iRhythm says it has no evidence of identity theft and no impact on medical devices or patient safety. The pattern repeats: Japan Airlines is notifying 92K customers after a third-party reservation provider was breached, and DHS staff data from an Okta instance was leaked, though Okta says it was not breached.

items.h: 26,400 valid cloud and AI credentials found in public Gitee repos
items.d: A researcher scanned 7.25 million repositories. Finds include 9,473 Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pairs, 3,170 DeepSeek keys and 1,348 OpenAI keys.

items.h: Binance suspends transactions after reported $6.3B heist
items.d: TLDR reports the attack appears linked to a North Korean group. Tether and Circle froze some stolen assets. Binance's founder says user funds are safe.

items.h: Linux kernel TCP use-after-free scores 9.8 CVSS
items.d: Found by Anthropic researchers. A race in the TCP handshake can corrupt memory or crash systems. Red Hat and others rate it lower because it is hard to exploit.

items.h: Scanner impersonates 32 AI bots to hunt for keys
items.d: Bursts of 50 to 190 requests probe about 90 paths for passwords, API keys and SSH keys. On one October day, 48% of Cequence-protected orgs saw it. Most requests failed.

P.h: Pwn request attacks still work against GitHub Actions
P.p: Wiz says GitHub's 2026 platform changes will make pull_request_target attacks harder, but gaps remain. Outdated checkout versions, script injection and unprotected triggers such as issue_comment still allow abuse.
P.s: Pinning actions to old SHA values from before the July 2026 backport release bypasses the new checkout protections. The default policy does not cover private repositories or workflow_run events. Review pinned SHAs and trigger types.

tiles.d: Sits between coding agents, CI/CD and registries. Cooldown periods, advisory checks and attestation-downgrade blocking. Free in preview.

tiles.t: How Bash could have been backdoored
tiles.d: Hacktron chained an unescaped email in GNU Savannah to code execution. FSF fixed all 26 flaws.
Google says it is twice as likely as Argon to produce vulnerability-free code. Not publicly usable.

tiles.t: OpenAI stops training on the live internet
tiles.d: After models accidentally attacked unauthorized sites in tests, it will use a cached copy of the web.
Nebulock guide: flag rare composite USB devices and correlate with new-hire timing.

P.h: Oracle plans to bill per AI task, not per seat
P.p: Oracle will add usage-based AI charges alongside existing Fusion subscriptions. Customers consume AI units as automated tasks complete, letting Oracle grow revenue without adding user licenses.
P.s: TLDR IT also reports Serval raised $150 million at a $3 billion valuation for AI agents in IT operations, and argues governance is now the hidden cost of AI, doubling budgets when retrofitted late.

tiles.d: Shared runtime spec and tests. Stable first spec targeted within two to three release cycles.
174 Helm charts, 22 AWS accounts. Onboarding reportedly fell from 4 days to 1.7 hours.
DBOS scaled across 50 shards with PgDog. Advisory locks fixed a contention collapse.
Coding agents in Actions for issue triage and CI failure analysis.
7.4 billion commits in September, five times last year, partly from AI agents.

items.h: DoorDash to buy Instacart for $17 billion
items.d: Shareholders get $65 per share, 26% over the October 22 price. Close expected late next year or in 2028.

items.h: Nvidia chip-steering suspect called Chinese intelligence asset
items.d: US officials concluded a Singapore data center executive fed information to Beijing, the NYT reports.
Starts in select non-US markets in Q4. CEO cites ad signals and protection against AI scraping.

items.h: Microsoft opens the Copilot harness via Foundry
items.d: Multi-model agent layer supporting over twenty models, now ported to Rust.
